description: Test and QA account registry schema. Real values are not stored in this repository: the registry is read at runtime from the TEST_ACCOUNT_REGISTRY_JSON environment variable and validated at boot. userIds and clientIds are excluded from scoreboard counts (exact ids). emailDomains narrows the scoreboard lookup. A pattern with qaEligible true exempts an account from the sign-up check only together with the QA registration secret; a pattern never exempts by itself.
